Text:
GYNECOLOGICAL SURGERY
Prophylaxis is indicated for abdominal or vaginal hysterectomy with either open or laparoscopic approach.  Antimicrobials are not indicated after incisions are closed.

References:

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 vol 70 pages 195-283
Therapy:
## Preferred prophylaxis

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

## Alternative in patients with beta lactam allergy

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision < AND > Aztreonam 2 grams IV over 20 minutes beginning 60 mins before incision
